svg.title: Closed-loop frequency responses and step responses of a two-pole feedback loop for phase margins of 30, 45, 60 and 75 degrees
svg.text: Closed-loop behaviour against phase margin (unity feedback)
frequency / unity-gain frequency of the loop
At 45° the closed-loop response peaks by about 30% near the crossover; at 60° the gain at crossover is exactly 1/β and the step
overshoots by under 10%; at 75° it is overdamped and slower.
